verdict.rationale: Docs claim agent mode can 'plan, explore, and execute work autonomously' and edit files across the workspace without manual context selection, implying some autonomous codebase traversal, and Copilot chat can explain concepts inline. However there is no explicit evidence of a dedicated 'map/explain the whole unfamiliar codebase' feature, no mention of repo-wide summarization or architecture diagrams, and no hands-on community reports validating this specific use case. Missing for 10: explicit codebase-mapping/summarization feature, evidence of automatic broad context gathering across an entire repo, and independent verification that it works well on large unfamiliar codebases.
